title: When Judges Agree and Are Wrong: Consistency-Accuracy Dissociation as a Blind Spot for Label-Free Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21128v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Label-free evaluation methods, such as self-consistency filtering, majority-vote aggregation, and agreement-based reliability scoring, rely on an implicit assumption that consistency can serve as a proxy for correctness when ground-truth labels are unavailable or expensive to obtain. In this paper, we test this assumption directly. Using four financial QA datasets (multiple-choice and free-form), ten consistency dimensions, and two frontier model families, we measure the joint distribution of consistency and accuracy at the level of individual examples rather than in aggregate. We find that 60% of all incorrect answers fall in the high-consistency region (consistency $\geq$ 0.8), and that 77.7% of these show complete answer collapse, i.e. identical wrong answers across all perturbation variants. translated_title: 当评判者一致却出错时：一致性-准确性脱钩作为无标签评估的盲区
translated_abstract: 无标签评估方法，例如自一致性过滤、多数投票聚合和基于一致性的可靠性评分，依赖于一个隐含假设：当真实标签不可获得或获取成本高昂时，一致性可以作为正确性的替代指标。本文直接检验了这一假设。我们使用四个金融问答数据集（包括选择题和自由问答）、十种一致性维度和两个前沿模型家族，在单个样本层面而非聚合层面测量了一致性与准确性的联合分布。我们发现，60%的错误答案落在高一致性区域（一致性≥0.8），其中77.7%表现出完全的答案坍缩，即在所有扰动变体中出现完全相同的错误答案。这种高一致性但错误的象限无法被任何仅基于一致性构建的评估信号所检测到，因为模型表现得…（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过对四个金融问答数据集的细粒度分析发现，60%的模型错误答案具有高一致性（≥0.8），且多数出现完全的答案坍缩，揭示了仅依赖一致性作为正确性代理的无标签评估方法存在根本性盲区。
en_tdlr: Using four financial QA datasets, this paper shows that 60% of incorrect model answers fall in the high-consistency region (≥0.8), exposing a fundamental blind spot in label-free evaluation methods that rely on agreement as a proxy for correctness.
